segments.description: Sarah Stone is the founder and CEO of the Women's Tennis Coaching Association. She is an internationally experienced high performance tennis coach who has spent extensive time working with the world's best juniors and WTA players. Betty Sakolowski, a high performance coach, has extensive experience including working for both tennis Australia for five years and various high performance environments both in the UK and Europe. Together they are representing Champion Academy in Australia and will be presenting on Creating Culture and Collaborative Coaching. Welcome Sarah and Betty to the conference. Hello everyone, my name is Sarah Stone and with me presenting this presentation is Betty Sakolowski. We work together at Champion Academy here in Australia and we're super excited to be part of Tennis Australia's conference again this year. Today we are making a presentation about Creating Culture and Collaborative Coaching. So for slide one Betty take it away. Thanks Sarah and thank you everyone. Looking forward to presenting this today. Really interesting topic and a debatable topic that I'm sure a lot of coaches seem to wrestle with a little bit on a day-to-day basis but Creating Culture and Teamwork is such a dominant and prominent part of coaching and I think it's a really healthy way to bring our players together and coaches together and bring their minds and their tennis IP together to be able to produce a high performance environment
